books.title: The Hollow Needle

books.summary: The famous gentleman-thief plans his most audacious crime yet: to steal the lost treasures of France.

books.title: Tarzan the Terrible

books.summary: Tarzan seeks to rescue his kidnapped wife from a lost city hidden in a prehistoric jungle.

books.title: Twenty Years at Hull House

books.summary: Jane Addams’ autobiographical account of the founding and operation of Hull House, one of America’s most famous settlement homes.

books.title: Recollections of Full Years
books.author: Helen Herron Taft
books.summary: Helen Herron Taft, wife of William Howard Taft, the twenty-seventh President of the United States, recalls her life married to one of America’s most influential political figures.

books.title: The Magic City

books.summary: A young boy, upset by his older sister’s recent marriage, builds an imaginary city out of blocks and household items and then finds himself living inside it.

books.title: The Necromancers

books.summary: A young woman watches with concern as her adopted brother turns to irreligious forces in the hopes of reconnecting with his dead fiancée.

books.title: Poetry

books.title: Short Fiction

books.title: Travel Essays
